faq_heading: 1 bedroom condos in Surrey: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a 1 bedroom condo cost in Surrey?
faq.a: Of the 1 bedroom condos in Surrey, 340 sold over the past year at a median of $374,950, with the middle half between $340,000 and $404,925.

faq.q: How long does a 1 bedroom condo take to sell in Surrey?
faq.a: The median was 32 days, and homes sold for 96.3% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Which Surrey neighbourhood has the most 1 bedroom condos sales?
faq.a: Whalley, with 263 of the 340 sales at a median of $370,000.

faq.q: Which buildings in Surrey have 1 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Park Avenue West (8 sales, median $372,000); Pura (8 sales, median $369,950); Plaza Two (6 sales, median $452,400); Park George (5 sales, median $417,500).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 1 bedroom condo in Surrey?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 1 bedroom condos that sold in Surrey was $343 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 1 bedroom condos in Surrey compare
A 1 bedroom condo in Surrey sold for $133,550 less at the median than a 2 bedroom one ($374,950 against $508,500, 406 sales). The strata fee was $343 a month against $461.
Of the 7 cities with 1 bedroom condo pages, Surrey has the 5th highest median price. Abbotsford is lowest at $324,950 and South Surrey highest at $485,000.
